about_the_game:
Hard Boiled Climate Change is a horde arena shooter where you control the weather.

Before each run, drop into the world and set the conditions — more rain, less humidity, shifting temperatures. What you trigger has consequences the moment you hit the arena. The horde adapts. So do you.

Every Condition Changes Everything Ice slows enemies — and you. A warm thaw turns the ground to mud and drags movement to a crawl. Rain supercharges electric weapons and cripples fire builds. Low visibility cuts your range. The horde reads the battlefield the same way you do.

Build Around the Weather Cold arenas favour ice weapons. Wet ground amplifies electric damage. Rare weather combinations unlock outcomes most players never see. Stack the right conditions and enemies collapse. Stack the wrong ones and you collapse instead.

50 Characters to Unlock Kill them to unlock them. Vikings, terminators, and everything in between — each with weapons from medieval maces to futuristic miniguns. Find the build. Find the synergy. Survive.

Key Features

  • Dynamic weather system with cascading, interconnected effects

  • Horde that adapts to the conditions you create

  • 50 unlockable characters

  • Weapons from maces to futuristic miniguns

  • Wave-based arena survival with upgrades between rounds

  • Deep build synergies tied to environmental conditions

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • VR Support: Non
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • VR Support: Non
